_meta.title: huiying Filter Procurement Reference
_meta.purpose: HS-code reference and MOQ / packing framework for huiying filters. Public common-knowledge HS codes for estimation; MOQ/packing described at framework level (no fixed numbers asserted).
_meta.disclaimer: HS codes are common-knowledge REFERENCE classifications — confirm with your customs broker / freight forwarder before shipping. MOQ and packing vary by SKU and program — confirm with Huiying sales.

hs_codes.label: Intake air filters for internal combustion engines
Oil or petrol-filters for internal combustion engines
Other filtering / purifying machinery and parts
hs_codes.applies_to: Cabin filters; some diesel fuel filters

moq_packing.framework: Varies by SKU and program. Export orders are commonly discussed per SKU / carton and per container; no fixed quantity is asserted here — confirm the MOQ per SKU with Huiying.
Standard export packing: neutral white box, colour box or OEM / private-label box; carton quantity varies by filter size. Confirm the exact packing per SKU with Huiying.
Supported, consistent with the main site: private-label and OEM-supply programs with consistent batch quality and testing documentation on request.
Mixed-container and multi-SKU orders are supported (consistent with the main site); OE / cross-reference matching to your market is provided.

export_markets: Asia, Middle East, Africa, South America and Europe (consistent with the main site).
contact: For verified HS classification, MOQ and packing per SKU, contact Huiying through huiyingfilter.com.
